purpose: Teach: 引き継ぐ/ジュエリー/賜物/見積り/雄大/摘出/要所/国税庁

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 退任予定の業務、本気で、絶対、引き継ぐ、絶対、計画、絶対、立てましょう
lines.en: We need to create a solid handover plan for the retirement—and we need to do it seriously.
lines.style: Purposeful opening. Measured pace. Clear authority without harshness. Lands on the twin imperatives with steady conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、ジュエリー、絶対、ラインアップ、絶対、拡充、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're genuinely committed to expanding our jewelry lineup, and I'm grateful for your partnership in that.
lines.style: Aligned and earnest. Warm but professional. Acknowledges the direction set. Slight emphasis on the gratitude—genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 長年のご支援の、本気で、絶対、賜物、絶対、お客様、絶対、感謝、絶対、伝えましょう
lines.en: The support we've received over the years is a gift. Let's make sure our customers know how much we appreciate them.
lines.style: Reflective, almost tender. Slow tempo. Quiet reverence for the years behind. Soft landing on the gratitude—not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規案件の、本気で、絶対、見積り、絶対、来週まで、絶対、まとめます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the quotes for the new projects compiled and ready by next week.
lines.style: Brisk, capable. Light uptick in tempo. Reassuring—this is handled. No flourish, just competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、雄大、絶対、な構想、絶対、社外にも、絶対、発信しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure our vision—our real ambition for this company—reaches people outside these walls too.
lines.style: Visionary but grounded. Slight lift in the voice. Leading without lecturing. Conviction that this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。問題点の、本気で、絶対、摘出、絶対、各部署、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working through each department to identify the real problems and address them head-on.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. Demonstrates active progress. No shortcuts—just thoroughness. Appreciative of the mandate.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 戦略の、本気で、絶対、要所、絶対、しっかり、絶対、検討しましょう
lines.en: And we need to examine the strategy carefully—hit the key pressure points with real rigor.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Settles into each clause. The voice of someone who thinks before moving. Disciplined.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。国税庁、本気で、絶対、への、絶対、報告書、絶対、期限内に、絶対、提出いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The tax office report will be submitted well before the deadline. You have my assurance.
lines.style: Final, definitive. Clean consonants. No hesitation. The voice closing a commitment. Professional reassurance.
